comment: Differences between 0.3.4 and the Rust backend that are known and accepted for every scenario; each names why. Patterns: `*` within one path segment, `**` any segments (README.md, 'Known differences'). Keep this list short: a scenario's own `known_diffs` is the better place.

known.why: Rust reports a parameter error as one item with the serde message and an empty `loc`; 0.3.4 (pydantic) named the field. The interface never reads `loc` (apps/desktop/app); the error code is still compared.

0.3.5 by design (node-generation.v1): FrameInfo, ViewResults and TreeSummaryResult carry the numbering their node ids belong to, so basket.add can refuse ids of a tree renumbered since (0.3.4 added whatever such an id named now). A new field: a value per backend run, not comparable.

0.3.5 by design (basket-confirm.v1): basket items carry `rev`, so basket.execute runs exactly what the user confirmed (0.3.4 ran what the basket held at that moment). A new field: a counter of the backend's basket, not comparable.

0.3.6 by design (issue #26, 「隐藏的文件夹」): ViewState says whether the folders of the setting treemap.hidden_folders are taken out of the picture (a view opens with them hidden). A new field; 0.3.4 had no such setting.
0.3.6 by design (issue #26): how many folders of treemap.hidden_folders the view's scan holds (the 「隐藏文件夹」 toggle is offered when any; 0 here, the list is empty by default). A new field.
0.3.6 by design (issue #26): the new setting treemap.hidden_folders, the folders to hide one per line, empty by default.
0.3.6 by design (issue #26): the new setting's default, no folders.
